code_index.name: code_index
code_index.description: Index source code into the knowledge graph for dependency and impact analysis. Example: code_index({ target: "src/" })

coverage_analyze_sublinear.name: coverage_analyze_sublinear
coverage_analyze_sublinear.description: Analyze code coverage with O(log n) sublinear algorithm and ML-powered gap detection. Example: coverage_analyze_sublinear({ target: "src/", detectGaps: true })

quality_assess.name: quality_assess
quality_assess.description: Assess code quality metrics and optionally run a pass/fail quality gate. Example: quality_assess({ runGate: true })

runGate.description: Evaluate all seven canonical measured quality checks; requires complete, valid evidence from the last 24 hours. Returns individual checks, not a static aggregate score.

defect_predict.name: defect_predict
defect_predict.description: Predict potential defects using AI analysis of code complexity and change history. Example: defect_predict({ target: "src/auth/" })

test_generate_enhanced.name: test_generate_enhanced
test_generate_enhanced.description: Generate unit/integration/e2e tests with AI pattern recognition and anti-pattern detection. Example: test_generate_enhanced({ sourceCode: "function add(a,b){return a+b}", testType: "unit", framework: "jest" })

sourceCode.description: Source code to generate tests for

filePath.description: Original source file path (used as the import target in generated tests; if omitted, generated tests reference the temp source)

language.description: Programming language (one of: typescript, javascript, python, java, csharp, go, rust, swift, kotlin, dart). Issue #474.

framework.description: Test framework to use. If omitted, derived from `language`.
